rollback_plan: 091 is additive-only: no column drops, no data migration, no backfill, and nothing writes solicitation_outreach until #628. Back out in code-then-schema order: (1) revert the branch merge, which restores run-spine.ts, read.ts, RunStateBadge.tsx and the pollers; (2) if the schema must also go, drop solicitation_outreach, drop the two job_outbox in-flight indexes, drop the solicitation_batches added columns + one-active-send partial unique, drop solicitation_asks_account_business_id_uniq, drop auto_approval_policies.daily_send_cap and the cross-persona pairing CHECK, and restore migration 074's persona (reply), action_class (posting) and veto_window_minutes (15,30) CHECKs, and restore the exact pre-091 definitions, which are 088's for agent_runs_kind_check / subject_type_check / kind_subject_type_pairing / agent_outcomes_outcome_kind_check and 071's for agent_runs_status_check (088 never touched status). Re-applying 071's widened-since text would reject existing rows carrying later kinds such as reply_vetoed_by_owner and solicitation_batch_built. Staging is dropped first, prod second — the reverse of the apply order. A code-only revert is sufficient while nothing writes the new columns; note that 'cancelled' becomes reachable as soon as #629's halt/veto path ships, not #630, so the code-only window closes at #629. The schema drop is the cold path.
